# Spec-Kit and SpecKit Companion

This repository runs spec-driven development with the `specify` CLI (GitHub Spec Kit) plus the
SpecKit Companion extension, which records each run into `specs/<NNN>-<slug>/.spec-context.json`
so the VS Code sidebar and the Companion canvas can show pipeline state.

## What Owns What

| Surface | Owner | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.specify/scripts/`, `.specify/templates/` | `specify integration upgrade copilot` | Shared with every spec-kit project |
| `.github/agents/speckit.*.agent.md`, `.github/prompts/speckit.*.prompt.md` | `specify integration upgrade copilot` and `specify extension add/update` | Commands are thin prompts that select an agent |
| `.specify/extensions/<id>/` | `specify extension add/update` | Companion, assess, bug, git, github, agent-context |
| `.specify/extensions.yml` | `specify extension` | Hook registry; extensions merge their hooks here |
| `.github/hooks/speckit.json` | `specify integration upgrade copilot` | Copilot runtime events (`userPromptSubmitted`, `agentStop`) |
| `.github/Skills/speckit-*/SKILL.md` | `tools/spec-kit/sync-command-skills.ps1` | Thin wrappers this repo generates |
| `specs/**`, `.specify/memory/constitution.md` | You | Never regenerated |

## Never Hand-Edit These

- Anything under `.specify/scripts/`, `.specify/templates/`, or `.specify/extensions/<id>/`.
- `.github/agents/speckit.*.agent.md` and `.github/prompts/speckit*.prompt.md` unless the change is
  meant to be lost on the next upgrade. Prefer a **preset** for a lasting command override.
- `.github/hooks/speckit.json` and `.specify/events.py`.

Editing any of them makes `specify integration status` report `modified managed files`, which
blocks the next upgrade until `--force` is used.

## The Two Copilot Layouts We Keep

Copilot can drive spec-kit through skills (`/speckit-plan`) or agents (`/agents` → `speckit.plan`).
This repo keeps both:

- `.github/agents/speckit.<command>.agent.md` holds the real command body and is managed by `specify`.
- `.github/prompts/speckit.<command>.prompt.md` is the `agent:` selector that makes the command
  appear in the prompt picker.
- `.github/Skills/speckit-<command>/SKILL.md` is a generated wrapper that points at the agent, so
  the `/speckit-*` entry point never holds a stale copy of the body.

After any CLI, integration, or extension change, regenerate the wrappers:

```powershell
pwsh -File tools\spec-kit\sync-command-skills.ps1 -RemoveStale
```

Non spec-kit skills (`agent-performance-audit`, `mtm-update-application-version`, and similar) are
hand-written and are ignored by that script.

## Upgrading (in this order)

```powershell
# 1. CLI itself (Windows: uv cannot replace its own tool dir, so use the uv command it prints)
specify self check
uv tool install specify-cli --force --from "git+https://github.com/github/spec-kit.git@v1.4.1"

# 2. The Copilot integration, keeping the agents + prompts layout
specify integration upgrade copilot --integration-options="--commands"

# 3. The Companion extension (its catalog entry is discovery-only, so `extension update` skips it)
'y' | specify extension add companion --from https://github.com/alfredoperez/speckit-companion/releases/download/companion-latest/companion.zip --force

# 4. The other extensions
specify extension update assess bug git github agent-context

# 5. Regenerate the skill wrappers
pwsh -File tools\spec-kit\sync-command-skills.ps1 -RemoveStale

# 6. Prove the setup
pwsh -File tools\spec-kit\verify-setup.ps1
```

Order matters: `integration upgrade` is rejected while preset artifacts are registered, and an
extension install rewrites agent/prompt files that the integration manifest tracks.

`integration upgrade` also regenerates `.vscode/settings.json` from its template, which drops the
`speckit.aiProvider`, `speckit.specDirectories`, and `speckit.defaultWorkflow` entries the Companion
needs. Re-apply them after step 2 — `verify-setup.ps1` fails until you do.

## Hooks

Two independent mechanisms, both already wired:

- **Command hooks** in `.specify/extensions.yml` (`before_specify`, `after_plan`, and so on). The
  command templates read this file and run the listed commands. Companion registers ten of them so
  every step records itself. `settings.auto_execute_hooks` is reserved and ignored by current
  templates — do not rely on it.
- **Runtime events** in `.github/hooks/speckit.json`, which call `.specify/events.py` on
  `userPromptSubmitted` and `agentStop`. These are what let the Companion record a step without a
  model in the loop. They need `python` on PATH (it is: 3.14.x with PyYAML 6.0.3).

The `git` extension adds its own hooks: `before_specify` creates the feature branch, and the
remaining entries are optional commit prompts. This repo already names spec branches
`<number>-<slug>`, so the branch hook matches how work is done here.

## Workflows

Two workflows are installed and runnable with `specify workflow run`:

| Id | Shape |
| --- | --- |
| `speckit` | specify → gate → plan → gate → tasks → implement |
| `speckit-companion` | specify → read recorded size → route (simple / oversized / normal) → implement or plan/tasks/implement → converge |

`.vscode/settings.json` sets `speckit.defaultWorkflow` to `speckit-companion` and
`speckit.aiProvider` to `copilot`, because the VS Code extension defaults to Claude.

## Verification

Run these after any setup change; all are read-only.

```powershell
pwsh -File tools\spec-kit\verify-setup.ps1   # 20 checks, exits non-zero on drift
specify --version                            # expect 1.4.1 or newer
specify integration status                   # expect no missing managed files
specify extension list                       # expect companion, assess, bug, git, github, agent-context
specify preset list                          # expect constitution-sync
specify workflow list                        # expect speckit and speckit-companion
python .specify/extensions/companion/scripts/doctor.py --all
```

Expected `integration status` caveat: `constitution-sync` replaces the `constitution` command, so
that agent and prompt always read as *modified*. Any other modified file is real drift.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Cause and fix |
| --- | --- |
| `specify integration status` says files are missing | Run `specify integration upgrade copilot --integration-options="--commands"` |
| `/speckit.constitution` or `/speckit.tasks` fails on a missing script | Same fix: those commands need `resolve-template.ps1` and `setup-tasks.ps1` |
| A command has no `/speckit-*` skill | Run `sync-command-skills.ps1` |
| Companion board does not show a spec | Check `.spec-context.json` exists; `python .specify/extensions/companion/scripts/derive-from-files.py` can rebuild it |
| Companion says its commands are out of date | `specify extension add companion --from ... --force` (the URL form, `extension update` skips it) |
| Task-to-issue conversion | It is `speckit.github.taskstoissues` now; the core `speckit.taskstoissues` was removed in spec-kit 1.3.0 |
